description: This file appears to be a shell script used for identifying, verifying, and upgrading firmware images specific to various network devices, including those from Netgear, Linksys, and Luxul, primarily for the bcm47xx platform.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs their hex representation.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte long from a file at a given offset.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Determines expected firmware filename pattern based on device model.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the type of firmware image by checking magic numbers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs various checks on the firmware image such as validation and matching device expectations.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX from a CHK firmware image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX from a CyberTAN firmware image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX from a Luxul (lxl) firmware image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX from an old Luxul firmware image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the firmware upgrade process based on detected image type.
